Response explicitly uses arccot in (0,pi), yielding four roots; reference contains only the two positive roots associated with the other convention.

proof: Let t=atan(x). With arccot range(0,pi), arccot(1/x)=t for x>0 and t+pi for x<0. Thus lhs=2|x|/(1+x^2). The equation reduces to |x|^2-6|x|+1=0, giving all four roots. With the discontinuous reciprocal-arctangent convention only the two positive roots remain.
